page: Amazon Web Services r6id.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 61947.22 and a Passmark CPU score of 57778.08. The system demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations with a Passmark database score of 26558.56, alongside strong static web serving throughput of 45.84 GB/sec. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall into the average tier, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1697.0.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r6id.16xlarge bundles high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage directly with a dense memory allocation, reducing the need for external block storage for high-throughput workloads. However, the lack of GPU hardware limits its utility for heavy parallel computing or large-scale AI training, though it maintains strong performance in small-to-medium LLM inference tasks.

This instance is suited for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads, such as large relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
description: Amazon Web Services r6id.16xlarge is a memory-optimized, storage-bundled instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 8375C processor. It features 64 vCPUs, 512.0 GB of DDR4 memory, and 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, supported by a 25 Gbps baseline network. This instance delivers strong multi-core CPU performance, as evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 57778.08, and excels in database operations and static web serving. While single-core speeds and memory bandwidth are average, the combination of high-capacity RAM and fast local storage offers a cost-efficient profile for data-dense workloads without requiring external storage attachments. The r6id.16xlarge is highly suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
